verdict.rationale: An employer tax-filing service like EAMS could plausibly offer an official CLI or bulk-filing tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only web portal filing (EAMS via SecureAccess Washington), paper and PDF forms, and how-to videos. Probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec, and nothing mentions a command-line tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
